messages:
marta: heads up — NVIDIA posted a hotfix that references CVE-2025-5678 affecting kernel module loading on 525.x drivers. We need a quick triage for Dedicated pools and Private deploys.
ajay: thanks. can someone pull inventory of driver versions across clusters? i recall some older nodes still on 515.
simon: i can run a query, will list kernels + driver pkg versions. also propose a minimal smoke matrix: nvidia-smi, simple forward pass on a small model, and an NCCL allreduce bandwidth check.
kevin: question — does this require changes to our KMS/HSM flow? the driver itself doesn't touch keys but our packaging pipeline signs driver artifacts. if the signing identity changes we need to rotate CMEK access.
sec-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-cves — check steps 1-6 (inventory, local reproduce, impact mapping, compatibility matrix, canary plan, audit update).
ajay: inventory output (quick): 12 nodes on driver 525.85, 7 nodes on 515.76, 3 on 470.x (edge). majority in us-west-2 Dedicated pool.
simon: proposed smoke commands:
```
# nvidia health
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv
# quick CUDA runtime check
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
# nccl bandwidth microbench (container)
./nccl-tests/build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 512M -f 2 -g 1
```
ajay: also recommend gating in the image build: fail build if package checksum/mismatch with upstream signed artifact.
kevin: for KMS: if we rotate signing key we'll need to update key access for the build-bot role in IAM. propose RBAC: create role gpu-driver-uploader with minimal kms:Decrypt for the signing key only. audit logs must record key use.
marta: agreed. add to checklist: RBAC role + temporary grant for canary rollout, and require attestation of signed artifact before promoting to Dedicated.
simon: compatibility validation notes: cuda 12.1 + cuDNN 9.x tested on 525.85 in staging; 515.x nodes may need cuda 11.x images. we should map supported combos and mark incompatible machines as drain targets.
kevin: timeline suggestion: today — inventory + reproduce in staging. tomorrow — build signed packages, update IAM role, run canary on 3 nodes in us-west-2. Friday — broader rollout with automated rollback on error.
sec-bot: reminder: update audit logging to include package install logs (/var/log/dpkg.log or rpm.log) and driver module load events (dmesg) into SIEM for the week following rollout.
marta: assign owners: simon -> inventory + smoke tests; ajay -> packaging + checksum gating; kevin -> RBAC/KMS changes; i'll own rollout coordination and postmortem.
ajay: noted. i'll open an infra PR with gating and artifact verification steps.
infra-bot: ci/build-gpu-driver-signed job queued: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/3421 — will report artifacts once complete.
simon: one more: NCCL hotpatch compatibility — add nccl-tests to canary job and capture perf baseline so we can spot regressions early.
marta: perfect. if nothing blocks, start triage and update this thread with short status. :thumbsup:
